name: decomposes a two-phase goal into steps that run in a workable order
input: Benchmark two candidate vector databases against our nightly query log, then recommend one for production and state the measurement that decided it.
notes: The recommendation is downstream of the benchmark: it cannot be made before the numbers exist. A plan that lists both steps without declaring that edge lets the orchestrator run them in either order.

assertions.why: benchmarking and recommending are separate pieces of work; a single subtask restates the goal instead of decomposing it
a two-phase goal that produces more than a handful of steps is padding the plan rather than dividing the work
the ordering has to be declared, not implied by list position — the orchestrator sorts on dependsOn and nothing else
the plan has to keep the measurement the recommendation rests on, rather than recommending straight from the goal text
